title: The Marquis of Mirabel to Carlos Coloma, Lyon, 8 December 1622 (BNE RES/227/122): key partial by our protocol, read in part

steps.what: Grid and syllabary deduced from the margin clears of Feria's letters (RES/227/120); key K-C01 frozen and measured once on Mirabel f.1v ll. 12-21 by M5: 0.333 vs 0.169.
CLE_C02 frozen, measured once on RES/227/127 f.1r against its margin clear: 0.761 vs 0.437 (gap 0.324).
CLE_C03 measured once on RES/227/128 f.1v: 0.690 vs 0.419 (gap 0.271); then H4 (MSS/18428 p. 15) burned without measurement (show-through, not a clear).
CLE_C04 measured once on MSS/18428 p. 44 right against its margin clear: 0.814 vs 0.466 (gap 0.348).
Letter read word by word, all 969 tokens covered in order; blind shape sheet of 16 questions applied: 425 words, 338 certain, 37 probable, 29 restored, 21 unresolved (88.2%).

141 = ello and 318 = oficio from the clear copy of MSS/18428 fol. 31; code values proposed by sense and the alphabetical order of the nomenclator (text-only Claude Fable 5.2 run); blind shape sheets FL2-C (controls 2/2) and FS1 (controls 2/2, 4 of 4 conjectures confirmed; position bias declared, answers confirmed by shape by Brice Dudout). No new key measurement. 421 words: 337 certain, 47 probable, 31 restored, 6 unresolved (91.2%). See BLIND-REREADING.md.

Integration of PR #417: the contributor's counts reproduce from the word table (421 = 337 / 47 / 31 / 6; main 425 = 338 / 37 / 29 / 21); the table covers the 975 tokens in order; 4 tokens of the transcription changed (the FS1 re-readings); a second decoder from key.tsv matches decryption.txt on 423 of 423 rows. Recount by the README read bar: 349/421 = 82.9% (code values placed by the sense, the text-only run's proposals and the xe words reclassed against the M16 pre-registration are not counted; 384/421 = 91.2% is the contributor's count). Order test: tau recomputed on key.tsv 0.74 on 45 code words (0.93 without the 8 sense-placed ones) against at most 0.31-0.34 for controls, so the nomenclator is alphabetical, but the contributor's exact figures (0.750 vs 0.463 on 37 values; 14 of 16 in the window) are not reproducible, the list and script not being in the repository. Two proposals do not fit strict order (127 DIFICULTAD, _52_ CRISTIAN); the note on 264 HONRA cites 267 INDIAS, which is not in key.tsv. key.tsv left as the frozen C04 with a header listing where the reading departs (_30_, _35_, bo, +, sa, 141). Images and sheets not seen (BNE Digital 403).

Every cipher passage of BNE MSS/18428 with a contemporary clear aligned with it (clear copies v33 g and v39 d - v40 g; margin clears v5 d, v6 g, v6 d, v7 d, v41 d), learning only, no measurement (no held-out passage left): 39 = BIEN, 4‡ = g, 60 = i, _49_ = BUEN, _56_ = CAPITULA, 225 = FUERTE, 308 = NUESTRO and 308 34ʳ = nuestro señor held by clears; the two 34 of the letter re-read 34ʳ on the image. 421 words: 347 certain, 42 probable, 28 restored, 4 unresolved (389 = 92.4%); by the README read bar 363/421 = 86.2% (contributor's recount). Key file unchanged (C04).

Integration of PR #543: the word table gives 421 = 347 / 42 / 28 / 4 and differs from 12 Nov in exactly 13 rows; a second decoder from key.tsv plus _39_ BIEN and 4‡ g reproduces decryption.txt on 414 of 423 rows (9 notation only); the clear passages of MSS/18428 as transcribed decode consistently with the key rows; the BNE images and clears were not seen (BNE Digital 403, 13 Nov). Strict count, sure words only: 346/421 = 82.2% (the contributor's 363/421 is the looser 12 Nov rule plus four words that stay probable: hizo, grande, havia, viene). Learning only, nothing measured.

MSS/18428 letter (PR #560): Inventory of the 112 images of MSS/18428: seven ciphered letters, all of 1622; five (six after 13 Nov) with a contemporary decipherment; only images 13 right - 15 left without one (issue #367). Held-out passage H6 (image 38 right) burned before any computation: its clear copy (image 39 right) had already been seen.

MSS/18428 letter (PR #560): Key CLE_M01 = coloma1622 key C04 + 23 values read on the contemporary clears of MSS/18428 (bound clear copies fol. 31 and images 39 right - 40 left, margin of image 44 right); adds ō = t (o with a cross, distinct from the Ð = n of C04). Frozen (4f09539f...) before the measurement.

MSS/18428 letter (PR #560): M01: one lexical measurement on part B (image 15 left, 192 tokens), pre-registered: score -2.381 against threshold -2.35; best of 200 controls -2.880, gap 0.499 against threshold 0.60; coverage 0.922.

MSS/18428 letter (PR #560): M02: metric recalibrated on burned passages only (whole-text lexical score); key CLE_M02 = CLE_M01 + 5 values of contemporary clears (4‡ g, 308 NUESTRO, _113_, _0_ REBELDE, 319 OTRO); part A transcribed in two independent passes and arbitrated, then one measurement: score -2.383 against threshold -2.25; best of 200 controls -3.413, gap 1.029 (threshold 0.30); coverage 0.928.

MSS/18428 letter (PR #560): The whole letter read word by word after both measurements, all 541 tokens covered in order: 250 words, 183 certain, 36 probable, 11 restored, 20 unresolved (87.6% certain + probable; 73.2% sure words only). Signs without a value read by sense are probable at two places or more, restored at one. English translation. 14 Nov 2026: the one sign of part B transcribed Ð re-read ō on the image (no count changes).

MSS/18428 letter (PR #560): The six ciphered letters of the volume that carry a contemporary decipherment, decoded on their 39 aligned segments with CLE_M02: 515 of 559 characters of the clears (0.921). Learning data (the values come from these clears), not a test.

Integration of PR #560 (mirabel1622 folded in as the document mss18428-13-15, one key one entry: the same system, CLE_M02 = C04 + values of the clears of MSS/18428). Own decoder from mss18428/key.tsv reproduces decryption.txt; strict recount 182/250 = 72.8% (contributor 183/250 = 73.2% sure, 219/250 = 87.6% with probable). M01 failed and M02 partial: the extended key is not validated. The contributor's re-reading of the sign in the H5 passage (MSS/18428 image 44 right, 'ministros') as o with a cross = t, not Ð = n, explains the 'Ð (n? / t) conflict' recorded in H5; the H5 score is not recomputed. BNE Digital answered 403 to a script again; images not seen by the project.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key rebuilt from the contemporary margin clears of other letters in the same system (the Duke of Feria to Coloma, RES/227/120-129), then applied to Mirabel's letter, which has no decipherment.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Word table of reading.md, which covers the transcription in order: 421 words, 347 certain, 42 probable, 28 restored, 4 unresolved (13 Nov 2026). Sure words only (integration of 13 Nov 2026): 346/421 = 82.2%, the certain words except 'casa' (code _60_ placed by the sense); probable, restored and unresolved words are holes. The contributor's count of certain + probable: 389/421 = 92.4% (384 on 11 Nov, 375/425 on 5 Nov); his recount by the looser rule of the 12 Nov integration (349/421 = 82.9%, which also counted 13 probable words read with the key): 363/421 = 86.2%. Second document (PR #560, MSS/18428 images 13 right - 15 left), counted separately, never pooled: strict 182/250 = 72.8% (the contributor's 183 certain words less 'Reina', code _A_ placed by the sense); the contributor's figures 183/250 = 73.2% sure and 219/250 = 87.6% certain + probable. fraction_read is the figure of the Lyon letter, the catalogued document (entry 1601).

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out tests (not docs/_validate.py), characters against contemporary clears, thresholds >= 0.85 and >= +0.30: C02 0.761 vs 0.437 (partial), H3 0.690 vs 0.419 (failed), H5 0.814 vs 0.466 (partial); C01 (M5, no clear) 0.333 vs 0.169 (failed); H4 burned without measurement (show-through). MSS/18428 letter (PR #560): key CLE_M02 (C04 extended from the clears of MSS/18428), lexical measurements, contributor's protocol: M01 on part B -2.381 against -2.35, gap 0.499 against 0.60: FAILED; M02 on part A -2.383 against -2.25, gap 1.029 against 0.30: PARTIAL. Not validated.

human_check.passage: res227-122, the boxed sign of 4 conjectures and 2 controls on sheet FS1 (f.1v ll. 5, 10, 14, 15, 18) and of 13 points and 2 controls on sheet FL2-C; earlier the 16 questions of sheet M16 (5 Nov 2026)
human_check.note: Blind choice of the sign shape on the BNE images among reference shapes cut from the same letter, no value or gloss shown; the sheets were prepared by AI agents, the choices are his alone. FS1: controls 2/2, 4 of 4 shapes confirmed, 4 tokens of the transcription changed (hízo, deseaba, bastaría, este); declared fault: the expected shape stood third on all six questions, so the controls cannot exclude an answer by position. FL2-C: controls 2/2, 3 points for the proposals, 4 against, 5 unknown marked signs. Sheets, rules and answers are not in the repository; not re-checked on the images by the project.

credits.note: transcription, key rebuilt from Feria's margin clears and tested on held-out clears (partial by his protocol, two of four measurements failed), letter read in part and translated (PR #279); two values from the clear of MSS/18428 fol. 31, code-value proposals and the blind shape sheets FL2-C and FS1, which he answered (PR #417, https://github.com/dbourdeau/cyphersolver/pull/417). 13 Nov 2026 (PR #543): the other clears of MSS/18428 aligned (39 = BIEN, 4‡ = g, 308 NUESTRO, 34ʳ SR ...); 346/421 = 82.2% sure words only, 92.4% on his count of certain + probable 14 Nov 2026 (PR #560): the letter of MSS/18428 images 13 right - 15 left (Mirabel to Gondomar, early 1622, the one cipher letter of the volume without a decipherment of the time) transcribed, key extended to CLE_M02 from the volume's clears (o with a cross = t, _0_ REBELDE), two pre-registered measurements (M01 failed, M02 partial), read in part (strict 182/250 = 72.8%).

the margin clears of the Duke of Feria's letters to Coloma (RES/227/127-129) and of MSS/18428 p. 44, used to build and test the key; the clear copy of MSS/18428 fol. 31 (141 = ello, 318 = oficio); the clear copies v33 g and v39 d - v40 g and the margin clears of v5 d - v7 d of MSS/18428 (39 = bien, 4‡ = g, 60 = i, 49 BUEN, 56 CAPITULA, 225 FUERTE, 308 NUESTRO)

texts.label: RES/227/122, f.1r-f.1v: cipher body of the letter
texts.summary: Louis XIII's proposals to the Duke of Savoy (Valtellina, help in case of rupture, Geneva), the French answer and the Duke's return from Avignon; Mirabel's talk with the Queen Mother on the deposit of the Valtellina forts, a Lorraine garrison and the capitulations of Aranjuez, the Catholic religion to be kept there; Richelieu, not of the King's Council, governs the Queen Mother.

reading_review.by: Claude Opus 5.5 (for Brice Dudout); re-read at integration for the project
reading_review.note: Read again as sentences 11 Nov 2026 by one AI reader after the blind sheets FL2-C and FS1 (Brice Dudout answered the shape sheets only; FS1 position bias declared, answers confirmed by shape). The letter construes as Spanish sentences throughout, with gaps: 337 certain, 47 probable, 31 restored, 6 unresolved of 421 words (91.2%), so read in part. Most new code values are machine proposals by sense and key order (restored at one place). Integration of PR #417 (12 Nov 2026): the normalised text read clause by clause against decryption.txt and translation.md; it construes where unmarked and the translation follows; 'Cristianos no resolvió' gives no clear sense. By the read bar 349/421 = 82.9% (code values placed by the sense not counted); grade kept at B. 13 Nov 2026 (contributor): the normalised text re-read after the changes from the clears of MSS/18428 ('o bien', 'viene', 'hizo grande instancia', 'el Rey nuestro señor, en que esperaba', 'nuestro señor había dudado'); 347 certain, 42 probable, 28 restored, 4 unresolved (92.4%); still read in part; grade B kept. Integration of PR #543 (13 Nov 2026): the changed rows re-read in context ('o bien en caso de rompimiento', 'el Rey nuestro señor, en que esperaba'); they construe; sure words only 346/421 = 82.2%.

texts.label: BNE MSS/18428 images 13 right - 15 left: Mirabel to Gondomar, Paris, early 1622 (cipher passages)
texts.summary: Early 1622, after Luynes's death: court gossip about Luynes's widow; Philip IV's order to send the French ladies home from Madrid and the Spanish servants from Paris; the Queen's confessor; Louis XIII's good faith and the capitulations of the Grisons treaties expected.

reading_review.by: AI agent for Brice Dudout; recount by the project
reading_review.note: Read as sentences by one AI reader after the two measurements: the cipher construes with the interspersed clear as Spanish sentences, with holes (20 unresolved and 11 restored words of 250; 87.6% certain + probable, 73.2% sure), normalised in reading.md and translated. Not checked by a human reader. Grade B: coherent but normalised from a raw syllabic decode. Integration check 14 Nov 2026 (project): strict share 182/250 = 72.8%: the contributor's 183 certain words less 'Reina' (code _A_, a value placed by the sense in coloma1622 and counted there as a hole); own decoder from mss18428/key.tsv reproduces the values column of decryption.txt (6 rows differ by notation only: faz/fez = que, + null). Images not seen (BNE Digital 403).

outcome.notes: New key for the Mirabel/Feria cipher of 1622 (key.tsv, CC BY 4.0), partial by our protocol. codes_open counts the underlined and three-digit code tokens of the letter (40 distinct): 2 has no value at all (39 = BIEN since 13 Nov 2026); many others have a value by the sense only (see gaps).

prior.where: No decipherment on the letter. No edition found (two web searches); nothing on DECODE, at Cryptiana (Tomokiyo) or in Lasry's lists; catalogue 1601 open, no target, PR or issue on origin/main (GitHub API, 895f21c4, 5 Nov 2026). Not read: M. Á. Guill Ortega, Carlos Coloma (2007); Herrero García (Avisos, 2023) on MSS/18428; the Codoin index.

human: Brice Dudout chose the target, set the rules (protocols and amendments hashed before each computation, one measurement per held-out passage, thresholds fixed in advance) and answered the three blind shape sheets (shapes only; M16, FL2-C, FS1). AI agents transcribed, rebuilt the key, measured, read and wrote up. No palaeographer checked the letter.
